candidate_relations.rationale: The production invocation contract fixes the evidence set before activation and forbids autonomous search or authority inference from source identifiers or locations, strengthening the Distiller directive's bounded-evidence and opaque-source rules.

The production-invocation tests fail closed on missing evidence, digest mismatch, output collision, and unregistered provenance, strengthening the Distiller core's requirement that every referenced provenance source resolve in the supplied registry.

The production-invocation tests preserve invalid RGP rather than repairing it and fail closed on evidence/provenance defects, strengthening the Distiller directive's no-semantic-repair and no-invented-provenance rules.
The RIL storage-verification workflow independently runs and compiles the R14 conformance suite, strengthening the R14 storage-verification contract as a separately testable read-only boundary.

The admission tests verify independent admission authority is required and a reconciliation recommendation alone is insufficient, strengthening the Steward handoff's strict reconciliation/admission separation.

The Steward-authorization contract requires an authorized human operator to approve an exact Steward-scope proposal and does not confer Steward status on the approver, strengthening the handoff requirement for explicit project-authorized Steward authority.

The Rupi authority-flow tests verify protected confirmation is non-authoritative, authority targets are never inferred, and each protected mutation has its own ceremony, strengthening the Rupi design contract's distinct authority primitive boundaries.

The role-registry tests verify the default Steward role creates no authority and role operations fail closed for forbidden or unknown roles, strengthening the role-registry contract's no-authority-from-membership rule.

The closed Rupi primitive map binds every consequential Rupi action to an accepted status, install, bootstrap, authority, repair, or human-agent primitive, strengthening the lifecycle adapter's composition-only architecture.

The grant-operation tests verify operation-specific grantor capability and apply-time validation of immutable issuance evidence, strengthening the bounded-authority-grant contract's revalidation and independent apply-time validation requirements.
The grant-operation tests' capability and immutable-issuance checks strengthen the Human-to-Agent contract's model of grants as bounded prospective authority rather than ambient agent authority.
The RIL reconciliation workflow independently runs and compiles the R12 conformance suite, strengthening the handoff's explicit semantic-reconciliation boundary before admission.

The ordinary-repair contract requires valid authoritative replay and routes invalid history to exceptional recovery without mutation, strengthening the exceptional-recovery contract's distinct protected recovery boundary.

The Phase-1 closeout explicitly retains human review and admission controls rather than authorizing automatic canonical admission, strengthening the handoff's separation of candidate/reconciliation evidence from admission authority.

The installer tests fail closed on drift, bad transport, incompatibility, unknown roots, and post-activation validation failure while preserving project files, strengthening the accepted deterministic local installer model.

The accepted-release greenfield retest shows bootstrap creates only the minimum project-owned knowledge structure and no canonical or authority state, strengthening the Rupi design contract's bootstrap-versus-authority boundary.

The Extraction Parity workflow explicitly runs PEMS/2 and RGP fixture parity checks, strengthening the compatibility fixture proposition that lossless and non-lossless representability are independently verified.

The Extraction Parity workflow runs guarded admission pressure tests and preserved candidate checks, strengthening the PEMS admission fixture set as active compatibility and admission-pressure evidence.
